title: DesktopConfig
description: Which coordinator the desktop app opens.

mode.description: `managed`: the coordinator of a runtime directory on this machine, started if needed. `remote`: a coordinator elsewhere, reached over the tailnet (HTTPS) or loopback.

home.description: Managed: the runtime directory (default ABLATIONKIT_HOME or ~/.ablationkit).

launch.description: Managed: start it as the systemd user service (it keeps running after the app quits), or as a child of the app (stopped when the app quits). Default service.

remote_url.description: Remote: the coordinator's origin. HTTPS (for example `tailscale serve`), or plain http only on loopback.
